Messages.Author: CVV
Messages.Body:
If I have Succubus Club in play, and I choose myself as the Methusaleh
to trade with; thus allowing me to freely move equipment, retainers and
locations between my own minions?

From the card text and rulings, it seems like I can do this.

Messages.Author: Peter D Bakija
Messages.Body:
CVV wrote:



The current text:

" During your untap phase, you may tap this card to trade with a Methuselah
who agrees to trade. You may trade pool and cards from your hand and cards
you control. The trade cannot result in either Methuselah have fewer cards
in hand than his or her hand size. Any additional terms can be established,
but none are enforced by the rules."

It specifically "either" Methuselah, so I'd think that you need two of them.

>
> It specifically "either" Methuselah, so I'd think that you need two of them.

Even if one could trade with oneself, doing so offers no mechanism for
moving equipment, retainers, or locations between oneself (since no
change of control occurs).

FWIW, trading with oneself is allowed. It results in tapping the Club (with
no other tangible effect).
